description: A REAL signed (logged_in=1, WEB_REMIX) YouTube Music browse response from Kaset's test fixtures, copied byte-for-byte. It is third-party data, not a capture made by this project and not evidence for this app's signed path. Its menus carry the real signed toggle shapes: 'Mark as played'/'Mark as unplayed' (CHECK -> ARROW_UNDO, feedbackEndpoint both sides, isToggled true/false), 'Pin to Listen again' (KEEP -> KEEP_OFF, feedbackEndpoint, no isToggled) and an 'add to playlist' toggle (ADD_CIRCLE -> PLAYLIST_ADD_CHECK, playlistEditEndpoint). None is a library toggle.
